sn56.25:1.1: jānato ahaṃ bhikkhave, passato āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi, no ajānato no apassato.
sn56.25:1.2: kiñca bhikkhave, jānato kiṃ passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti:
sn56.25:1.3: idaṃ dukkhanti bhikkhave, jānato passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti jānato passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti.
sn56.25:1.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, jānato evaṃ passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti.
sn56.25:2.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
